_keys_note: Discrete(11): 0-7 = compass (0=N,1=E,2=S,3=W,4=NE,5=SE,6=SW,7=NW), 8=OPEN, 9=KICK, 10=SEARCH. Arrows map to the cardinals; y/u/b/n to the diagonals; O/K/S to the door/search commands. turn_based:true is required -- noop is action 0 (=move N). Keep the message Controls text in sync with 'keys' by hand.

text: Explore the dark corridors between rooms and reach
the goal ( the down-staircase, > ). Open or kick
doors, and search walls for hidden passages.
ARROWS       move  N / S / W / E
Y / U        move diagonally  NW / NE
B / N        move diagonally  SW / SE
